anomalies.description: Multiple players and staff engage in mutual physical combat near the basket and sideline, with pushing, grabbing, and shoving observed among several individuals in red and white jerseys and suits.

A large, chaotic crowd of players, coaches, and spectators surges onto the court, resulting in violent group clashes, climbing over barriers, and uncontrolled physical contact across a wide area—beyond isolated fighting.
